articles.image_title: Schnapsbrennen: Providence - January 12: Head Distiller Dan Neff holds a handful of malted corn, an ingredient in their vodka, in the distillery in Providence, RI on Jan. 12, 2022. The Industrious Spirit Company (ISCO) is Providence's first-ever distillery since Prohibition. And this boutique distillery, founded by CEO Manya K. Rubinstein, is making the world's first-ever oyster-distilled vodka. Ostreida Vodka starts as regionally-grown, organic, non-GMO corn. ISCO ferments and distills the corn in small batches and it is then combined with local oysters for the last distillation. A portion of the proceeds are going to GreenWave, an organization that trains and supports ocean farmers in the era of climate change by working with coastal communities to create a blue economy. (Photo by Lane Turner/The Boston Globe via Getty Images)
